decisions.proposed_text: Dùng chiến thuật “Late Surger” để thắng Kikuka Sho trong thời tiết [Mưa], đồng thời dùng chiến thuật “Front Runner” để thắng Japan Cup (Senior Class)
decisions.reason: Both running-style labels use noncanonical Vietnamese wording; embedded context requires Late Surger for 居中 and Front Runner for 领放 while Senior Class is already correct.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded common.style.late_surger and common.style.front_runner; locked Senior Class.

decisions.proposed_text: Thắng Oka Sho, Yushun Himba, Shuka Sho và Japan Cup, đồng thời hoàn tất huấn luyện khi duy trì Mood “Great” trong tất cả các Cuộc đua
decisions.reason: The fixed Mood state 绝好调 must be Great; current 'Tuyệt hảo' is explicitly forbidden by embedded canonical context.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded state.mood.great.text_data requires Great; race.generic requires Cuộc đua.

decisions.reason: Speed, Turf, 800, 15, and the generic Cuộc đua label all preserve the source requirement; the numeric-risk flag does not indicate a semantic loss here.
decisions.terminology_basis: Embedded Speed/Turf terms and locked race.generic are all present.
